composition: 뾰족한 사선 쐐기 실루엣 내부에 폭풍 하늘·산악·절벽을 담고 번개와 파편이 경계의 앞뒤를 넘나듦. 실루엣 바깥 투명.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. TEST 3 — LIGHTNING. Create one background-only premium fantasy RPG splash art with a deliberately SHAPED SCENIC BACKDROP. No characters.
Reference 1 supplies sharp asymmetric splash silhouette and overlapping shards. Reference 2 supplies clean anime color planes, a large geometric background mass with internal depth, and effects passing in front of and behind that mass. Do not reproduce either reference's people, weapons, birds, wings, water or symbols.

ESSENTIAL COMPOSITION:
The BACKGROUND ITSELF has a clear silhouette: an ascending, slightly tilted, jagged lightning-shaped WEDGE, broad in the middle and tapering into several long sharp points, like three staggered angular storm panels forming a fractured oblique diamond. This is not a full rectangular sky and not merely a thin empty border. The large shaped mass is FILLED with a beautifully rendered miniature thunderstorm environment: layered deep indigo and blue-violet thunderclouds, distant jagged mountains and a faint luminous storm horizon inside it. It must read first as one strong pointed splash silhouette, then as a deep storm world contained within that silhouette.
Give the overlapping angular background planes subtle visible edges and different depths, but avoid a thick uniform picture frame, literal doorway, giant sword, shield, flat lightning logo or poster design. Leave asymmetrical transparent notches between a few panels; most of the background shape contains rich scenery. At least half of the visible artwork should be actual painted scenic background, not just scattered props.

LIGHTNING AND SPATIAL DEPTH:
A brilliant branching WHITE-GOLD lightning strike cuts diagonally from the upper storm sky toward fractured stone near the lower foreground. One dominant bolt with purposeful angular direction changes, branching thinner cyan-blue electrical filaments and very selective golden sparks. The main bolt emerges from within the storm, disappears briefly BEHIND one projecting dark shard, then crosses IN FRONT of the scenic silhouette and reaches a low charged rock fissure. Some forks break outside the background boundary into transparent space. This boundary crossing and occlusion must make the composition feel dimensional.
Foreground: a limited cluster of tilted cool-gray stone plates, sharp edges catching warm electric light, a few larger airborne shards. Midground: a broken rocky ledge and illuminated strike location, with a quiet darker area above for possible later character placement, but no human-shaped blank. Background: storm cloud volume, distant mountain layers, subtle receding lightning. Large dark-blue shapes, selective brilliant points; do not fill every region with equal noise or emission.
The rock cluster supports the spatial scene and follows the same rising diagonal wedge rhythm. It must not turn into a large round pedestal. Detached shards and bolts partially escape the geometric mass, while staying comfortably inside the overall canvas.

STYLE / PALETTE:
Polished hand-drawn 2D anime splash art, matching reference 2's clarity: precise thin contours, crisp broad shaded planes, controlled soft gradients inside clouds, faceted stone, clean electric edges. Spatial depth through perspective, relative scale, overlap and atmospheric contrast. No photorealism, 3D render, rough oil paint or flat decorative vector pattern. Deep indigo / muted violet / cool slate gray for the background; luminous white-gold main strike with limited electric cyan secondary branches. Unify lighting: lightning lights the clouds and shard edges in the same direction.

OUTPUT:
ONE standalone isolated shaped splash scene on TRUE TRANSPARENT outside space. The storm scenery remains visible and filled INSIDE its jagged silhouette; exterior and a few deliberate notches are transparent. Never fill the entire rectangular canvas with landscape, never leave the internal scenic mass empty. Square canvas, the complete group occupies about 80–85 percent of width and height, leaving generous transparent padding so all sharp tips, bolts and stones remain uncut. No text, labels, title, watermark, UI or panel borders. No character, person, face, animal, bow, arrow, tree or cherry blossom.
